Media and XHR fixture

One clip served by the fixture server (not a data URL), which answers Range requests with 206: the browser asks for it in pieces, the way a media element loads a file, and the page seeks once so a second range goes out. The same clip once more under an extension-less URL (/stream?clip=2, the shape of a CDN's /videoplayback?...), metadata only, for a request observer whose type comes from the URL's extension. Beside them, one XMLHttpRequest and one fetch of the server's JSON, so a request observer sees the media and the xmlhttprequest kinds from one page.
